# Baba Associates

> Baba Associates is a Rohini-based home builder and real estate consultancy operating from Sector-16, Rohini, Delhi. Founded by Sh. Goverdhan Dass Wanvani in 1998 as a builder, the firm has delivered over 56,000 sq. ft. of constructed space in Rohini and expanded into full real estate consultancy in 2010. It handles new construction on customer-owned plots, ready-to-move freehold builder floors, resale properties, and renovation and interior work across Rohini and nearby North-West Delhi.

## Pages

- [Home](https://rohinihomes.in/): Overview of Baba Associates, services, featured projects, testimonials and FAQs.
- [About Us](https://rohinihomes.in/about-us/): Company history since 1998, founding team profiles and professional experience.
- [Services](https://rohinihomes.in/services/): New construction, new home sales, resale properties, home redesign, renovation, and building on customer-owned plots.
- [Gallery](https://rohinihomes.in/gallery/): Photos of completed residential projects, interiors and renovations.
- [Contact Us](https://rohinihomes.in/contact/): Phone numbers, email and office address in Sector-16, Rohini, plus an enquiry form.

## Key Facts

- Founded in 1998 by Sh. Goverdhan Dass Wanvani as a builder in Rohini, Delhi.
- Began operating as a real estate consultancy in 2010, co-founded by Mr. Lalit Wadhwani.
- Delivered over 56,000 sq. ft. of constructed space in Rohini.
- Handled over 3 lakh sq. ft. of real estate as a consultancy, serving thousands of clients.
- Offers both a turnkey construction model (ground zero to completed building) and a consultancy model (expert guidance, scope-based charges).
- Currently developing freehold luxury-concept builder floors in Rohini: 2 BHK (84 sq. yds), 3 BHK (130 sq. yds) and 4 BHK (170 sq. yds).
- Deals in residential properties, plots & floors, luxury properties, commercial spaces, warehouses and farmhouses.
- Serves all sectors of Rohini plus nearby North-West Delhi localities including Shalimar Bagh, and select projects across Delhi NCR.
- NRI-friendly: offers remote video walkthroughs, documentation support and full project supervision.
